title: Dog head
note: The classic four-fold model, and the one that took three tries. Folding a square on its diagonal always leaves the spine at 45 degrees, so the head came out tilted however the later folds were chosen -- the paper has to be held turned, which is what DIAMOND is. Then: halve to a triangle with the spine level and the snout down, drop both top corners for ears, tip the chin up.
